d: Own the numbers. Strengthen governance. Drive financial accuracy.
Are you an experienced accountant who thrives on precision, structure, and accountability? Do you enjoy being the link between daily accounting operations and high-quality financial reporting?

At Boutiqaat, we’re looking for a Senior Accountant to oversee core accounting activities, support financial and audits, and strengthen financial governance across the business. Play a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of financial records, supervise accounting operations, support monthly and annual close, coordinate audits, and guide junior accountants while continuously improving processes and controls.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical accounting knowledge with leadership and ownership.
q: Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field
CPA, CMA, or ACCA (part-qualified or completed) is an advantage
Experience in retail, e-commerce, or structured corporate environments preferred
Prior experience supervising or mentoring junior staff is a plus
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, reconciliations)
Strong experience with accounting software and ERP systems
Familiarity with reporting, consolidation, and audit tools
Strong English communication skills (Arabic is an advantage)
Strong knowledge of IFRS/GAAP and financial reporting standards
Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking
Ability to interpret and validate complex financial data
Strong time management and deadline-driven mindset
Proactive, accountable, and comfortable working independently
Ability to perform under pressure without compromising accuracy

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.
Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact.
Apply now and be part of something exciting!
r: Review and supervise day-to-day accounting activities (GL, AP, AR, cash, fixed assets)
Ensure accurate recording of journals, accruals, prepayments, provisions, and adjustments
Verify supporting documentation and correct classification of transactions
Guide accountants on complex accounting treatments and entries
Lead month-end and year-end closing activities within agreed timelines
Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules
Support preparation of financial statements in line with IFRS or applicable standards
Ensure consistency and reliability of financial data across systems and reports
Provide variance analysis and financial insights to management
Perform and review bank, supplier, customer, and GL reconciliations
Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies promptly
Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, and segregation of duties
Support statutory compliance and documentation requirements
Monitor budget utilization and highlight variances
Act as a key contact for internal and external auditors
Prepare audit schedules, documentation, and explanations
Follow up on audit findings and ensure timely closure
Maintain audit-read financial records and documentation
Contribute to strengthening financial governance and control frameworks
Provide technical guidance on accounting standards and best practices
Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and reporting efficiency
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on accounting and operational matters
Support ERP enhancements, system improvements, and automation initiatives
